svg.title: The batched trajectory executor
svg.desc: Many trajectories share one fused simulation. The no-jump branch of every channel is chosen without the state whenever a uniform draw falls below the bound α, so every random number is drawn up front and only the small windows that hold a jump run operation by operation.
svg.text: channel: may jump only if u ≥ α
Exact: the Born weight of K* is at least α for every state, so u < α selects it without the state;
only u ≥ α needs the qubit's reduced density matrix, from the rows themselves.
